artworks.title: View of Rome
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape with various buildings, including domed structures in the distance. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, capturing the sprawling architecture leading up to the prominent domes. The skyline displays a large dome, likely a cathedral or historical building. The buildings closest to the viewer have terracotta-tiled roofs, creating a detailed tapestry. The image is in monochromatic sepia tones, emphasizing the architectural details. The color palette is warm and earthy.

artworks.title: Two Satyrs in a Forest
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures seated outdoors. On the left is a nude human with short hair. On the right is a mythological creature resembling a satyr, with human features from the waist up and goat features below. Both are seated in a lush, foliage-filled setting with a large tree trunk in the background.

artworks.title: Jacob Balthazar Schitz
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person in profile view, facing right. The individual has wavy, shoulder-length hair and distinct facial features. They are wearing a garment with a high collar and buttons. The background has intricate cross-hatching patterns. Below the figure, text reads "IACOB BALTH: SCHITZ" followed by "Año 1670".

artworks.title: Battling Tritons
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical battle scene among sea creatures. Two dominant figures stand amidst tumultuous waves. Each possesses the body of a human with strong, muscular features, but also the tail of a fish, characteristic of merfolk. One figure, on the left, is captured mid-action with a weapon raised above its head. The figure on the right holds a shield with a fierce expression, ready for defense as water splashes around them. To the right, another similar creature looks on. The scene is set against a backdrop of tall, waving reeds and a few birds can be seen flying above. The detailed linework creates a sense of movement and intensity within the composition.

artworks.title: Study of a Jockey
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person shown from the side, with their upper body visible down to waist level. The individual is seated, slightly leaning forward, with their shoulders hunched and head inclined forward. Their facial features are drawn in profile, with a sharp nose and a subtle chin line; the shadow of a prominent brow and shaded eye area conveys a contemplative posture. They are wearing a cap that covers the person’s hair and a jacket with a raised collar, accompanied by folds indicating material texture. The background is plain with no additional objects or elements, emphasizing the focus on the figure's posture and clothing. The artist's signature, "Degas," is visible in red in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Two Studies of a Jockey
artworks.medium: black chalk, charcoal, and pastel on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two men at approximately half-body length, seated side by side and facing away from each other. The man on the left is leaning forward, with his head and shoulders turned towards his left. He has a beard, a cap, a long-sleeved shirt with rolled-up sleeves, light-colored pants, and shoes. The man on the right is sitting upright, also with a cap and a beard, and dressed in a similar style. They appear to be holding onto an object between them. The background is a simple, sketch-like surface with minimal details.

artworks.title: Study of a Jockey (M. de Broutelles)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a charcoal drawing of two profiles of a man from the shoulders up. The man is shown leaning forward slightly, with his head angled downwards. He has a beard, mustache, downward-sloping nose, and hair covered by a cap. He wears a simple shirt or jacket. The background is plain, emphasizing the man's sketches on light-colored paper.

artworks.title: Le Hibou (The Owl)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and saltground, with burnishing and roulette in black and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This drawing contains an allegorical and surreal scene, featuring a central framed image of an owl next to an open book on a pedestal. The words "PAUCA PAUCIS" are below the central image. Surrounding this central scene are various interconnected vignettes, including a cityscape, ships' masts, ghostly figures in the sky, and a figure sitting with a feather pen amidst swirling mist and smoke. The drawing is detailed and intricate, blending fantastical and real elements.

artworks.title: Klosterhof in Franken (Franconian Cloister)
artworks.description: The image shows an interior perspective looking out into a courtyard with a checkered floor leading to two large arched openings. Two figures stand in the courtyard with their backs turned. Trees and architectural elements can be seen beyond the arches. The scene is portrayed in an etching or engraving style with fine line work defining the architecture and natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown to create depth. Figures inside the building are engaged in conversation or activity, adding life to the structured environment.

artworks.title: Ruine Frauenkirch mit dem Grabmale der Genoveva und des Pfalzgrafen Siegfried (Ruins of the Church of Our Lady with the Tombs of Genevieve and Count Siegfried)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ruined church interior. The image shows a dilapidated sanctuary with large gothic arches and columns. The roof is partially missing, allowing the view of the sky and some foliage through the remaining structure. In the center-right, there is an altar-like structure or tomb with sculptural elements. The stone walls are worn with age, and vegetation can be seen encroaching upon the building. Natural light filtering in through the openings highlights the details of the stonework.

artworks.title: A Lion Hunt
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This painting depicts a hunt with animals and riders. The scene shows a confrontation between humans on horseback and various wild animals like lions and a leopard. A lion is depicted in the center apparently pouncing on a figure beneath. The horses react to the chaos, and the painting includes details of armor and clothing textures. The image is dynamic and intense, conveying the tension and action of the scene in a style reminiscent of Peter Paul Rubens.

artworks.title: A Grotesque with Diana of Ephesus and Diverse Animals
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 42.2 x 16.8 cm (16 5/8 x 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central figure surrounded by two human-like entities with wings, a structure above the central figure supported by two bird-like creatures, two stags with impressive antlers on either side of the central figure, and a creature with features of a dog and a bird in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Veil of Saint Veronica
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Plattemontagne after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 45.5 x 35.3 cm (17 15/16 x 13 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man's face, depicted with long, wavy hair flowing past his shoulders. He has a serene expression, wide eyes looking directly at the viewer, a straight nose, and a slightly parted mouth. He has a neatly trimmed beard. The face has droplets of sweat or tears on the forehead and cheeks. It is imprinted on a piece of cloth tightly hung on a frame with a wreath of thorns below. The background is simple fabric within a rectangular border, presented in sepia tone.

artworks.title: The Body of Christ
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Plattemontagne after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure lying horizontally on his back with his hands crossed over his midsection. His head is slightly elevated on a pillow or fabric, and his eyes are closed. He has long wavy hair, and a cloth is draped around his waist. There are marks on his hands and feet, and draped linens and a crown of thorns are nearby. The setting is a stone-like enclosure with a carved inscription.

artworks.title: Harvesting
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite with scratching-out and touches of gum arabic on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Brown Foundation, Inc., Houston
artworks.description: The image displays a rural landscape from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high in the image, showing distant hills and fields under a dramatic sky with clouds. Sunlight breaks through the clouds, illuminating the landscape. In the foreground, figures are harvesting around a hay wagon. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the trees and light. The color palette includes browns, greens, golds, blues, and grays. A tree with slender branches frames the scene on the right.

artworks.title: The Head of Ullswater
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a wide landscape from an elevated point. The horizon is high up, with rolling hills, distant mountains, and a sky with light clouds. In the foreground, there are rocky terrain and a valley with trees and vegetation. The brushstrokes are textured but restrained, creating a serene appearance. The color scheme includes earth tones and soft grays, with the sky in pale blues and whites.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1722: The Temple of Janus
artworks.artist: Giovanni Girolamo Frezza after Alessandro Specchi (architect)
artworks.description: The image features a detailed line drawing of an urban scene from an elevated perspective, showing a large, bustling piazza with various people. Grand buildings line the horizon, with a neoclassical structure in the center. The precise and detailed brushstrokes create realistic architectural details and figures. The monochromatic sepia color palette highlights the intricate line work. People, including soldiers and elegantly dressed individuals, occupy the space. Stately buildings in the distance add depth, while the cloudy sky above contrasts with the structured elements below.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1755: A Triumphal Bridge with Antiquities from Herculaneum
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural scene with an arched bridge and elaborate sculptures. The scene features a grand, monumental structure with an arched bridge leading to a stately building adorned with columns, statues, and intricate designs, topped by a figure holding a staff or flag. Columns with statues of riders on elephants flank the bridge's entrance. A water body is depicted under the bridge with small boats and figures. The sky has wisps of clouds, giving a dramatic backdrop to the architectural showcase.

artworks.title: The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1755: A Royal Hunting Lodge
artworks.description: The image shows an elaborate architectural structure with multiple columns, decorative elements, figures in various activities, a central ornate section with windows and sculptures, a dramatic plume-like feature on the roof, water fountains with statues on the sides, a low horizon line, and a monochromatic scheme with detailed line work. The background features a sky with cloud forms.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1757: The Colonnade of the Athenian Lyceum
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Pozzi after Giuseppe Palazzi (designer) and Paolo Posi (architect)
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural structure resembling a grand portico or facade from a frontal viewpoint. The structure features symmetrical columns and sculptural details, with fine, detailed lines and cross-hatching in an engraving technique. Sculptures and urns adorn the roof, and various figures are present in the lower section. In the background are large statues against a textured sky filled with stylized clouds.

artworks.title: The Mountain Nymph, Sweet Liberty
artworks.description: The head and shoulders of a young woman with pale skin and long hair nearly fill this vertical, sepia-toned photograph. Shown against a dark background, she looks directly at us. Her nose is straight and her lips closed. Wavy curls piled over her forehead suggest that her hair is partially pulled back or pinned up around her oval face, and it falls behind her shoulders. Her garment has wide lapels and is worn over patterned clothing.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Child
artworks.description: The image depicts a young child lying on their side. The child is positioned on their right side with their head resting on their left hand, while the other hand lies on their lap. The child has short, light-colored hair and closed eyes. They are wearing a knee-length dress with puffed sleeves and a lace collar. A broad-brimmed straw hat with a light-colored band is placed nearby. The scene includes potted plants on both sides of the child, and behind them, there is a stone or cement balustrade. The image is framed in an ornate, gold-colored border.

artworks.title: Derwentwater
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a body of water, a shoreline with trees, hills, and a sky in the background. The scene is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving it a timeless quality. The color palette is warm with light brown and beige hues. The image resembles an early photograph rather than a painting.

artworks.title: The Three Sleepers: Sophia Finlay, Harriet Farnie and Brownie
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image shows two children, both visible from the waist up. The child on the left sits with one arm resting on the piece of furniture behind them, eyes closed and head slightly tilted, with long, straight hair parted in the middle. They wear a garment with fringed detailing along the arms. The child on the right is lying with their head resting on their arms, eyes closed, with hair that appears to be similarly parted and straight. This child is dressed in plaid with a collar visible at the neckline. Around them, there is a piece of furniture draped with richly textured fabric adorned with tassels. The background seems to be blurred, focusing attention on the children.
